title: Took some feedback and I think my cards are getting there
author: LatentBlade
selftext: Thanks to everyone who gave me feedback. I actually used a lot of those comments as prompts and played with the results. I'm still tweaking a few details but I'm very happy with the progress.

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: Make something then make it good!

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body:
These were my cards when I started this project

https://preview.redd.it/np73xbn0xs1h1.png?width=709&format=png&auto=webp&s=3e762f49cb2ce32f1c8aad144e1eeba73e97f412

replies.author: Motor-Travel-7560
replies.body: This is the most sinisterly confusing trading card I have ever seen.

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: I think the problem might be I'm only showing you half the cards...these all flip over and have counter play

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: Can you explain what you mean by sinisterly? I want to make sure I'm understanding you

replies.author: Motor-Travel-7560
replies.body:
Just the part about there being an announcement of revenge, but the sentence cuts off. How am I supposed to know what is coming to wreak vengeance on me? Very sinister.


(I'm just kidding around)

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: Oh that was a joke title of the early cards "Revenge of the sea"! The sea is coming for you! See how much better the game is now? You can read the card!

replies.body: please tell me this is for a pacman roguelike

comments.author: MeasIIDX
comments.body:
I think it's moving towards the right direction. The biggest thing for me is that you land on really good iconography for the elements. The cyclone/whirlwind just seems a bit jarring. I liked the simplicity of the previous version's cloud/wind but that doesn't quite match either to me.

Keep it up!

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: I'm trying to move away from pixel art everywhere. Once I made the card images better, the pixel art started looking out of place. I just switched element icons out this weekend and need to adjust to how I feel about them.

replies.body:

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
is it a physical card? why do you need the flipped title?

I don't like how the cloud icon in the middle. 

I think a combination of 1 + 3 would be good; (or just do something about those rectangles)

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: This game started out as a physical card game and is now a deckbuilder roguelike (because play testing was easier). Cards each can played 1 way on your turn and 1 way on your opponents turn.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I see. if you can find a card game that plays similar to yours, you can probably take inspirations from their card layouts. Right now, your cards look quite amateurish (I don't know exactly what is off but I can tell it is not from a mobile game or a TCG. it looks like someone made it for fun)

comments.author: SlickWillyDeluxe
comments.body:
Some suggestions I think would clean this up a bit.

- Make the font size a little smaller in all places. 
- instead of a basic black outline on text, try an embossed outline and a bit thinner.
- let justify the header text. This will make a big effect on making it look more professional IMO.

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: Thanks. This is the sort of feedback I'm looking for. Actual things I can try and see how I feel about them.
